notes.title: VERSION 0.32.1
notes.content: [h1]VERSION 0.32.1[/h1][h2]General[/h2][list][*][p]Came back safely from PAX West 2025 :)[/p][/*][*][p]Added local prediction to shooting.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled thickness of tracers.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Attribute Icons (form factor temporary, this is the foundation for the Attribute Recontextualization update).[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Resist effectiveness now multiplied by 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Closing a Shop menu now resets the filter.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Death Grace Multiplier", a new multiplier reduces respawn time based on how many times you’ve died. [/p][list][*][p]This is applied before final clamps (net worth + round scaling). [/p][/*][*][p]That means if your net worth/round progression is high enough, this effect won’t matter — it mainly impacts hyper-late game scenarios to help close matches faster.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Example: 30,000 Net Worth at Round 1, will outscale any Death Grace effects.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]First death:  60%[/p][/*][*][p]Second death:  75%[/p][/*][*][p]Third death:  90%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Server Status in the Play Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Taskbar flash when queue pops.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Blitz Game notes.title: VERSION 0.31.1
notes.content:
[h1]General[/h1]
• Added Match Results caching.
• Increased enter sound for Bazaar from 8 seconds to 12.
• Increased enter sound for Teleporter from 8 seconds to 12.
• Made Queue Pop sound louder.
• Added Spawn Invulnerability FX and Buff Icon.
• Respawn timer for Blitz reduced by 15%.

[h1]Maps[/h1]
[h2]NP_Ballroom[/h2]
• Adjusted stair collisions to be smoother.
• Added Faction colors.

[h1]Minions[/h1]
[##]Neutral Creeps
• Reduced Neutral Creeps field of vision by 40 degrees.

[h1]Armory[/h1]
[h2]Hand Cannon[/h2]
• Increased ammo count from 6 to 7.

[h2]Zipper[/h2]
• Range Modifer decreased from 0.82 to 0.7.

[h1]Items[/h1]
[h2]Cloak of Toph[/h2]
• Added activation sound.

[h2]Toy Cannon[/h2]
• Added SFX and VFX.

[h2]Comet[/h2]
• Added SFX.

[h2]Jump Pad[/h2]
• Added SFX.

[h2]Banner of Regeneration[/h2]
• Added SFX.

[h2]Banner of Frenzy[/h2]
• Added SFX.

[h2]Knife of Aistrek[/h2]
• Added SFX.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
• Fixed a bug where Net Worth wouldn't account for items in inventory.
• Fixed a bug where players could access the shop from above, indefinitely.  
• Fixed a bug where Warlord's Horn and Nova's Necklace shared the same cooldown.
• Fixed a bug where Headshot Multipliers, Deny Multipliers, and Range Multipliers weren't applying properly.

notes.title: VERSION 0.30.1
notes.content:
[h1]General[/h1]
• Added Total Weapon DPS and Headshot Multiplier on Armory.

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
[h2]Zipper[/h2]
• Base damage decreased from 7 to 6.
• Headshot percentage decreased from 1.1 to 0.8.
• Range decreased from 8192 to 5406.

[h2]Breachr[/h2]
• Range decreased from 8192 to 5406.

[h2]Hand Cannon[/h2]
• Base Damage increased from 10 to 12.
• Damage percentage increased from 0.9 to 1.0.

[h2]Light Rifle[/h2]
• Range decreased from 8192 to 6144.

[h2]Military Rifle[/h2]
• Recoil Y Modifier decreased from 600 to 550.

[h1]Maps[/h1]
[h2]NP_Ballroom[/h2]
• Added Roofs to the Medium Camp on the second floor and the Bazaar.
• Changed rotation of all camps to face more appropriate entrances (to minimize paid actors).

[h1]Items[/h1]
[h2]Cloak of Toph[/h2]
• Now blocks Minion health bars.
• Blocks Minion paths again.

[h2]Smoke Pearl[/h2]
• Now blocks Minion health bars.

[h2]Toy Cannon[/h2]
• Added hitmarker cue on hit.

[h2]Cursed Grimoire[/h2]
• Added hitmarker cue on hit.

[h2]Comet[/h2]
• Added hitmarker cue on hit.

[h2]Violet Urn[/h2]
• Added hitmarker cue on hit.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
• Fixed a bug where if a spell with a cast-indicator was cast during packet lost, the spell would go on cooldown without being cast.
• Fixed a bug where players would have floating numbers for damage appear for Venomous Charm, even without line of sight.
• Fixed a bug where Renewal Mechanism did not properly have the Regen tag.

notes.title: VERSION 0.29.3
notes.content:
[h1]VERSION 0.29.3[/h1]
[h2]General[/h2]
• Implemented measures to prevent queue spamming.
• Added helper text for players when they're physically in the Commons Shop or Bazaar.
• Added helper text for selling items.
• Fully-automatic weapons now keep firing if the Fire Button is held down throughout the reload animation.
• Added queue timer.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
• Fixed a bug where Free Spells didn't work on every spell in the Training Stage.
